apps.title: LIVE FFT
apps.description: Real-time spectrum analyzer for the device microphone: FFT / PSD with averaging and peak hold, STFT and wavelet spectrograms, and a triggered scope.

apps.title: D'ALEMBERT WAVES
apps.description: Travelling waves on a plucked string: f(x−ct) + g(x+ct), with the mirror images beyond the fixed ends that become the reflections.

apps.title: DISPERSION
apps.description: Group velocity vs phase velocity: a wave packet whose envelope outruns its crests, and two-tone beating with markers riding each.

apps.title: BEAM WAVE TYPES
apps.description: The four wave solutions of the beam equation animated side by side: two evanescent near-fields and two travelling waves.
